name: jimkit
description: A self-hosted toolkit you extend with addons: convert, edit and inspect files, write, hash, format. Runs in Docker or a Proxmox LXC.

scripts.dev: node scripts/gen-addons.mjs && npm run dev -w apps/web
scripts.build: node scripts/gen-addons.mjs && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/gen-addons.mjs && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/site
scripts.build:site: node scripts/gen-addons.mjs && npm run build -w apps/site
